text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoooa! I don't know why, but it feels like I'm bubbling over with energy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: And the interesting thing is, I'm the only person who knows it. Hm…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, I know just how I can use this to my advantage.
